title: LLMs are Brittle to Simple Code Transformations: Introducing CETBench - A Benchmark for Code-Equivalence Checking
abstract: arXiv:2506.04019v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study how well LLMs can determine whether two programs are functionally equivalent. This is an important problem because benchmarking code equivalence helps assess LLM capability in tasks such as code rewriting and translation. To this end, we introduce CETBench - Code Equivalence with Transformations Benchmark - built from a repository of programs that may solve the same or different tasks. Each dataset instance is created by sampling a program pair and applying a random sequence of predefined code transformations, yielding either equivalent or non-equivalent pairs. Our analysis shows that even simple transformations cause a significant performance drop in state-of-the-art LLMs on code-equivalence checking. These challenges are further amplified in the cross-lingual setting when comparing programs written in different languages. translated_title: 大语言模型对简单代码变换十分脆弱：提出CETBench——一个代码等价性检测基准
translated_abstract: 我们研究了大型语言模型（LLM）判断两个程序在功能上是否等价的能力。这是一个重要问题，因为对代码等价性进行基准测试有助于评估LLM在代码重写和代码翻译等任务上的能力。为此，我们提出了CETBench（Code Equivalence with Transformations Benchmark，基于变换的代码等价性检测基准），它由一个程序仓库构建而成，这些程序可能解决相同或不同的任务。每个数据集实例通过采样一对程序并应用随机序列的预定义代码变换来生成，从而得到等价或非等价的程序对。我们的分析表明，即使是简单的变换也会导致最先进的LLM在代码等价性检测任务上出现显著的性能下降。在跨语言场景下（即比较用不同语言编写的程序时），这些挑战会被进一步放大。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种简单的基于微调的方法来提升LLM在该任务上的性能。
tldr: 本文提出了代码等价性检测基准CETBench，发现大语言模型即使面对简单的代码变换也会出现显著性能下降（在跨语言场景下尤为严重），并提出一种基于微调的简单方法来提升模型性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CETBench, a benchmark for code-equivalence checking, showing that LLMs suffer significant performance drops even under simple code transformations (especially in cross-lingual settings), and proposes a simple fine-tuning-based approach to boost performance.
